description: GENERIC handoff.md section template (RETURN contract — teamwork-preview native port Phase 2) — customizable seed transplanted by transplant-bundle (git-worktree-isolation) to external projects. brief2dev itself does not read this JSON (Option C — live path uses fixed JS constant .claude/scripts/lib/worktree-plan-template.mjs#DEFAULT_HANDOFF_SECTIONS). The `sections` array follows the schema of .cli/lib/section-template-renderer.mjs#renderTemplateFromSections (5 block types: static/checklist_group/field_list/fenced_block/table, {{var}} placeholders). Deep-equal to DEFAULT_HANDOFF_SECTIONS (pinned by drift regression test in tests/unit/worktree-plan-template.test.mjs). handoff.md is not automatically created at worktree initialization — presence itself is a signal that a RETURN contract was authored, created on-demand during session transitions (ensureWorktreeHandoff).

lines: (Required — Verified facts only. Backed by file:line, command output, or commit sha evidence. Keep inferences separate in Logic section)
(Required — Rationale leading from observations to conclusions. Explicitly state uncertainties)
(Required — Unverified items, known risks, and potential pitfalls for successors)
(Required — Final status in a single sentence + list of deliverable paths. Categorize remaining tasks as checkpoint / done / incomplete)
(Required — Commands and procedures for successors to independently reproduce this conclusion)

_adapt.purpose: External project adaptation guide (brief2dev code does not read this key — guidance only).
_adapt.how: Customize heading wording and section count. The core of the RETURN contract is the separation of Observation and Logic + accompanying Verification method — preserving these 3 elements is strongly recommended. 5 block types (static/checklist_group/field_list/fenced_block/table) are evaluated by .cli/lib/section-template-renderer.mjs.
_adapt.wiring: This JSON is not automatically loaded by runtime code. To apply, wire target project code to pass `renderHandoffTemplate(branch, { sections: <this JSON's sections array> })`, or replace DEFAULT_HANDOFF_SECTIONS in transplanted worktree-plan-template.mjs directly with this JSON's contents. Authored on-demand at session transitions (not auto-created at worktree-init to preserve presence-signal).
